title: Modern Kitchen Transformation
description: A complete kitchen overhaul featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a stunning center island that transformed this dated space into a modern chef's dream.
challenge: The original kitchen had limited counter space, poor lighting, and outdated appliances that made cooking a chore rather than a joy.
solution: We reconfigured the layout to create an open concept design, installed custom soft-close cabinets, added under-cabinet LED lighting, and created a large center island with seating.

title: Luxury Master Bathroom
description: A spa-inspired master bathroom renovation featuring a walk-in shower, freestanding tub, and custom double vanity.
challenge: The cramped, outdated bathroom needed a complete redesign to create a relaxing retreat within the existing footprint.
solution: We removed the old tub/shower combo, installed a spacious walk-in shower with rainfall head, added a freestanding soaking tub, and built a custom double vanity with ample storage.

title: Whole House Renovation
description: A comprehensive whole-house renovation that modernized a 1980s home while preserving its character and charm.
challenge: The home had good bones but needed updates throughout - from flooring and lighting to kitchen and bathrooms.
solution: We developed a phased renovation plan that allowed the family to remain in the home while we transformed each area, completing the project on schedule and budget.
